warnings: Gable roof, ridge (สันหลังคา) along the middle of bay B-C parallel to x. T1 = steel trusses on grids 2 and 3 spanning A to D (10.00 m, eave 1.60 each side). T2 (both gable ends, grids 1 and 4) = คานรับแปด้านสกัด: per its detail on แผ่นที่ 3 it is the gable wall whose inclined beam is R1 (labelled R1 along the rake), supported by the C2 columns at A, B, C, D.

R1 is printed three times along each gable wall (A-B, B-C, C-D) and is recorded as those three plan segments; R1 is inclined, so span_length_m is the horizontal projection, and the B-C segment rises to the ridge at mid-bay and falls again (the ridge line is not dimensioned, so no grid line is invented there). The T2 entries carry no own concrete — their member is R1 — so a consumer must not price T2 again.
R2 runs along rows A and D at the column heads (รูปตัด ก-ก shows R2 under the truss seat, ขยายหัวเสา). Its section (0.10 x 0.20, 2-Ø12, ลูกโซ่ Ø6 @0.15) is printed on แผ่นที่ 3.
Purlins (แปเหล็ก C-100x50x20x3.2 @0.90-1.00) are not drawn on this plan — they are specified on the truss details and are recorded there, not as plan elements.
